title: T2-FY23 - Team Interviews - Template
content:
Suggestions on questions we can ask the teams for OKR “Software delivery process” (data driven):

Target audience is DevOps contact in team and persons that persons invite - probably a developer or BA.

  • How are you using the DORA metrics and the reports?

  • Do you have any goals with regard to software delivery and operations?

  • Is there any additional information, or modifications, that you would like to see in the DORA metrics reports?

  • Is there any other data that you would like to gain insights from?

  • What would you like to improve in your delivery release process?

  • Are you using monitoring?

    • How much time is spent analyzing data?

    • Do you have statistics on defects found using monitoring?

    • Other indicators of value of monitoring?

  • How much do you work with accessibility and what is your strategy in that area?

  • What do you see is DevOps team role in IPEX?

  • Which branching strategy are you using?

  • How do you work with security?

    • Do you use SSO for test environment(s)?

    • Do you have continuous threat analysis e.g. theat modelling?

    • Do you have a security responsible in team?

  • How do you work with costs?
